description: This file defines a Python class 'LLMTextProcessor' which processes and aggregates text frames from a Large Language Model (LLM). It handles different types of frames such as 'LLMTextFrame' and 'InterruptionFrame', utilizing specified text aggregators to combine or manipulate LLM output for downstream consumption. The class includes methods for processing frames, handling interruptions, resetting internal state, and managing the aggregation of text data before output.

classes.name: LLMTextProcessor
classes.description: A processor class for handling and aggregating Large Language Model (LLM) text frames, providing customization and frame processing logic.

methods.name: __init__(self, *, text_aggregator: Optional[BaseTextAggregator] = None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the LLMTextProcessor with an optional text_aggregator, defaulting to SimpleTextAggregator if none provided.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes different types of frames, performing aggregation and handling specific frame types accordingly.

methods.name: _handle_interruption(self, _)
methods.description: Handles interruption frames by invoking the aggregator's interruption handler.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the text processor and its aggregator.

methods.name: _handle_llm_text(self, in_frame: LLMTextFrame)
methods.description: Handles LLMTextFrame instances by aggregating their text content and outputting aggregated frames.

methods.name: _handle_llm_end(self, skip_tts: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Handles the end of LLM responses, flushing remaining aggregated text and outputting it if present.
